annotations.title: Take back the answer recorded on a quote

description: Takes back an acceptance or a refusal recorded on a sale quote or a purchase order by mistake: the quote is unanswered again, and its quote_status is sent, expired or draft as its facts say. A deal of the crm module that the answer had won or lost opens again at the stage it was at. Refused on a quote with no answer (document_not_answered). Held to the company's agent_posting as a posting is. Ask the user before calling it. This session follows each company's agent_posting.

document_id.description: The sale quote or purchase order whose answer was recorded by mistake.

name: undo_document_answer
